metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the figure 8 exercise, which if perfect for fixing upper back muscle tightness, stiffness, aches, and pains.

This exercise will put the upper back through dynamic movements, which target a lot of muscles in a short amount of time. It works great for pain caused from bad, forward leaning posture.

As a bonus, it can be done at home (or work) and may give instant upper back pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS.

Let us know how it works for you!
